name: squadfy-functions
description: Squadfy domain server on Cloud Functions (spec 019, ADR-0010)

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-squadfy --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore,database,storage,functions "vitest run --project emulator"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project squadfy-5233d --config ../firebase.json --only auth,firestore,database,storage,functions --import=../emulator-data --export-on-exit
